did_you_know.title: John Willis Menard (R-LA) becomes the first African American elected to the Unit…
did_you_know.text: John Willis Menard (R-LA) becomes the first African American elected to the United States Congress. Because of an electoral challenge, he is never seated.

did_you_know.title: MLK Holiday Signed Into Law
did_you_know.text: President Ronald Reagan signed legislation establishing Martin Luther King Jr. Day as a federal holiday, to be observed on the third Monday of January each year.
